## Left Column

This column demonstrates how two-column layouts work. Each column is an independent block stack — you can mix any block types freely.

### Feature Rundown

Two-column mode divides the page into two equal-width sections separated by a configurable gap (default 5 mm).

- Ideal for **morning briefs**: weather + agenda side by side
- Great for **comparison views**: two weather locations, two days
- Useful for **reference + notes**: content on one side, writing lines on the other

### Tips

Keep blocks that should stay together in the same column. Blocks within a column never split across columns — they always wrap to the next page if they overflow.

### Quote of the Day
